screen.title: Notifications
screen.emptyDesc: You will see match and tournament updates here.

challenge_received.title: You've been challenged
challenge_received.body: Someone challenged you to a match.

challenge_accepted.title: Challenge accepted
challenge_accepted.body: Your challenge was accepted. Time to play!

challenge_cancelled.title: Challenge cancelled
challenge_cancelled.body: A match challenge sent to you was cancelled.

score_recorded.title: Score recorded
score_recorded.body: A score has been submitted for your match. Confirm or dispute.

score_confirmed.title: Match confirmed
score_confirmed.body: Both players confirmed the result. The match is official.

score_disputed.title: Score disputed
score_disputed.body: A player has disputed the match result and proposed new scores.

dispute_accepted.title: Dispute accepted
dispute_accepted.body: Your proposed scores were accepted. The match is official.

dispute_countered.title: Dispute countered
dispute_countered.body: Your score proposal was rejected. The other player submitted a counter-proposal.

cancel_requested.title: Cancellation requested
cancel_requested.body: Your opponent has requested to cancel this match.

cancelled.title: Match cancelled
cancelled.body: Both players agreed to cancel the match.

auto_confirmed.title: Match auto-confirmed
auto_confirmed.body: No response received — your match result was confirmed automatically.
